description: A PHP source file for a web UI page that displays WiFi status and configuration information for a gateway device. It includes HTML and JavaScript for the front-end, retrieves WiFi parameters from the device, and displays statuses, MAC addresses, and uptimes for 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz WiFi radios.

methods.name: div_mod
methods.description: Divides two numbers by repeated subtraction, returns quotient and remainder as an array.
